name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-vi-dark-world
title: Final Fantasy VI - Dark World
description:
Requested by KingDemonic666 during the 2020 winter C3. The wind SFX are not included in this port due to them being very difficult to replicate accurately and recreating them accurately would take up a lot of unnecessary audio RAM.

This is a eerie piece of music that would be fitting for Ghost Houses or haunted levels.
